count_expert_num_tokens: count the number of tokens assigned to each expert from topk_ids tensor
moe_kernel_quantize_input: quantize MoE kernel input tensor to fp8, int8, nvfp4, mxfp4, mxfp8, or mxfp6 dtype
normalize_scales_shape: normalize quantization scale tensor shape to 2D format
normalize_batched_scales_shape: normalize batched quantization scale tensor shape to 3D expert format
